followupIncidents.scopeNote: Separate user-reported no-output startup-order incident. Exception location matches the prior fault family, but this dump's full stack was not obtained. Loaded shim does not prove Bridge app or device output was started.

Third distinct user-reported manual Editor crash. Triggering operation and quit phase are unknown; do not classify as an observed close crash. Matching fault location does not establish cause. User requested that investigation stop with cause unresolved.

Fourth distinct user-reported crash; user trigger was Preview-to-Play. Do not classify it as Editor close. Memory values are the reported budget counter/estimate, not physical memory peaks. Matching native fault location does not establish a causal link to InsufficientMemoryException.
